meta.title: MiroFish - Predict Everything
meta.description: MiroFish - Social Media Opinion Simulation System

home.heroDesc: From a single document, {brand} extracts reality seeds to auto-generate a parallel world with up to {agentScale}. Inject variables from a god's-eye view to find the {optimalSolution} in complex group dynamics.
home.slogan: Let Agents rehearse the future, let decisions prevail
home.systemReadyDesc: Prediction engine on standby. Upload unstructured data to initialize a simulation sequence.
home.step01Desc: Seed extraction & memory injection & GraphRAG construction
home.step02Desc: Entity extraction & persona generation & Agent config injection
home.step03Desc: Dual-platform parallel sim & auto-parse requirements & temporal memory
home.step04Desc: ReportAgent interacts with the post-simulation environment via rich tools
home.step05Desc: Chat with any simulated individual & converse with ReportAgent
home.promptPlaceholder: // Describe your simulation or prediction requirement in natural language
home.workspaceDesc: Upload source material and describe a scenario to prepare a simulation. Use the runtime monitor to inspect local settings and gateway activity.

step1.ontologyDesc: LLM analyzes document content and simulation requirements, extracts reality seeds, and auto-generates a suitable ontology structure
step1.graphRagDesc: Based on the generated ontology, documents are auto-chunked and sent to Zep to build a knowledge graph, extracting entities and relations, forming temporal memory and community summaries
step1.buildCompleteDesc: Graph build is complete. Proceed to the next step for simulation environment setup.
step1.platformChoiceDesc: Choose the platforms to prepare and run for this simulation.

step2.simInstanceDesc: Create a new simulation instance and pull world parameter templates
step2.generateAgentPersonaDesc: Combine context to auto-extract entities and relations from the knowledge graph, initialize simulated individuals, and assign unique behaviors and memories based on reality seeds
step2.dualPlatformConfigDesc: LLM intelligently sets world time flow, recommendation algorithms, each individual's active hours, posting frequency, event triggers, and more based on requirements and reality seeds
step2.initialActivationDesc: Auto-generate initial activation events and hot topics based on narrative direction to guide the simulation world's initial state
step2.setupCompleteDesc: Simulation environment is ready. You can now start the simulation.
step2.roundsConfigDesc: MiroFish auto-plans to simulate {hours} real-world hours, each round representing {minutesPerRound} minutes of elapsed time
step2.customTip: For first-time runs, we strongly recommend switching to 'Custom Mode' to reduce rounds for a quick preview and lower error risk
step2.personaDimExperienceDesc: Complete behavioral trajectory in this event
step2.selectedPlatformConfigDesc: LLM sets time flow, recommendation algorithms, activity and event parameters for the selected platforms, based on requirements and reality seeds.

step5.chatWithAgent: Chat with any individual in the world
step5.reportAgentDesc: A conversational version of the report generation agent with access to 4 professional tools and MiroFish's complete memory
step5.toolInsightForgeDesc: Aligns real-world seed data with simulation state, combining Global/Local Memory for cross-temporal deep attribution analysis
step5.toolPanoramaSearchDesc: Graph-based BFS algorithm that reconstructs event propagation paths, capturing the full topology of information flow
step5.toolQuickSearchDesc: GraphRAG-based instant query interface with optimized indexing for fast extraction of node attributes and discrete facts
step5.toolInterviewSubAgentDesc: Autonomous interviews that conduct parallel multi-round dialogues with simulated individuals, collecting unstructured opinion data and psychological states
step5.chatEmptyReportAgent: Chat with Report Agent to explore report content in depth
step5.chatEmptyAgent: Chat with simulated individuals to understand their perspectives

comparison.interpretation: These are recorded action attempts, including failed attempts. They do not measure successful interactions, completed rounds, causal effects, model quality or prediction accuracy.
comparison.unavailableNote: An em dash means unavailable, not zero. Partial counts include only readable, valid observations.
comparison.modelNote: The configured model is saved metadata; it does not establish which model actually ran.
comparison.differenceNote: Every difference is right minus left. A difference is available only when both relevant sources are complete.

savedActivity.title: Saved activity
savedActivity.scope: Explore the latest saved run for this simulation ID. Restarting replaces its saved files; previous attempts are not archived here.
savedActivity.searchNote: Search individual saved string values, including nested arguments and results, names, types and timestamps. Enter 1–200 characters; spaces are literal. Case-insensitive search uses Unicode case folding, without accent removal or normalization. No regular expressions or matching across separate values. Match case has no effect without a phrase.
savedActivity.outcomeNote: Outcomes use saved success flags, not independently verified execution; missing or nonboolean flags are unknown.
savedActivity.matchPreview: First matching saved string · excerpt up to 240 characters; may omit the match tail
savedActivity.filterNote: Platform, agent ID, round and action type match exactly. Agent and round IDs are nonnegative whole numbers; zero is valid. Apply changes to read a page.
savedActivity.orderNote: Saved source/file order: Twitter then Reddit, each in forward file order; legacy combined files keep their own file order. This is not a merged timestamp timeline.
savedActivity.attemptNote: Each row is a recorded attempt, including failed and unknown outcomes. Identical attempts remain separate.
savedActivity.draftNote: Filters have changed. Apply filters to read matching activity; the previous page is no longer displayed.
savedActivity.statusNote: Saved status describes the files observed, not verified ownership of a live process.
savedActivity.partialNote: Partial counts cover only readable, valid observations. An em dash means unavailable, not zero. Downloads contain only this displayed page.
savedActivity.tableCaption: Saved action attempts in source/file order
savedActivity.unavailable: Saved observations are unavailable for this selection. Refresh when saved files are available.
savedActivity.noMatches: No matching recorded attempts in the readable saved sources.
savedActivity.outOfRange: This page is beyond the matching recorded attempts. Return to the first page.

runtime.title: Local runtime monitor
runtime.scope: Observe loaded settings and this backend process’s gateway activity. This page does not contact models or Neo4j, start services, or run capability checks.
runtime.autoRefresh: Auto refresh · every 5 seconds after completion
runtime.error: Could not read a valid runtime observation. Refresh to try again. Any previous observation below is stale.
runtime.exportError: Could not download this observation. Try the download again.

stateNotes.disabled: Local gateway monitoring is disabled in cloud mode. No cloud configuration is included.
stateNotes.inherited: This process inherits a gateway owned by another process. Its policy and activity are unknown here.
stateNotes.not_running: No gateway is running in this process. An idle workspace is normal and is not evidence of model readiness.
stateNotes.transitioning: The owner is changing gateway state. No current policy or counters are available in this observation.
stateNotes.starting: The gateway is starting. This does not establish model or graph availability.
stateNotes.running: The gateway listener is running. This is gateway activity, not model readiness.
stateNotes.closing: The gateway is closing while accepted work drains or is cancelled. Capacity is not confirmed released.
stateNotes.closed: This gateway instance is closed. Its available counters describe that instance only.
stateNotes.failed: The gateway has failed. This observation alone cannot establish model or graph availability.

runtime.gaugeNote: Admitted connections include header/body parsing, health requests and response delivery. Active and queued gauges count only chat, embedding or model-list requests that entered forwarding. Queue size is measured directly, not inferred from connections.
runtime.outcomeNote: Each started forward ends with exactly one outcome. Success means a complete validated upstream response. Timeout and cancellation reflect what the forwarding task observed, which may differ from the browser’s status. Work still active or queued has no terminal outcome yet.
runtime.rejectionNote: Admission rejections count connections before parsing. Early protocol rejections are not forwarded failures.
runtime.processNote: Counters reset with each gateway instance. Each backend process has its own owner; these are not global application totals, agent counts or GPU utilization.
runtime.configNote: These are settings loaded by the backend. Restart the backend after changing its environment configuration. Validation covers the displayed settings only and does not check running dependencies.
runtime.contextNote: Configured context is an application budget, not the model’s actual capacity. Changing it does not enlarge the model server’s context. The input character guard is not a tokenizer.
runtime.cloudNote: This monitor describes the local preset only. Local configuration is unavailable in cloud mode; no cloud endpoints or credentials are shown.
runtime.limitsTitle: Loaded limits and actual gateway policy
runtime.limitsNote: Loaded settings do not reconfigure a running gateway. Its actual policy is shown separately when this process can observe it. Unknown means unavailable, not zero.
runtime.limitsCaption: Socket admission capacity equals concurrency plus extra admission capacity. Parsing and health connections also occupy this budget; it is not a guaranteed number of fully parsed queued requests.
runtime.capabilityTitle: Capability checks are not run here
runtime.capabilityNote: Idle and running states are not readiness checks. This observation does not verify model compatibility, graph connectivity, simulation quality or whether a local server delegates remotely.
runtime.doctorNote: For an explicit capability check, follow the existing CLI doctor instructions. The doctor contacts local services and may load already-installed models into memory.

issues.output_exceeds_context: Output token cap must fit within configured context

readiness.title: Check local setup
readiness.scope: Run a small check with fixed synthetic prompts and a read-only database query. This may start the shared gateway, load already-installed models and use local compute.
readiness.limits: No model downloads or graph writes. A pass checks capabilities at the displayed time; it does not measure speed, model quality or a full simulation.
readiness.error: Could not read a valid check result. The backend may still be working. Refresh to observe it again.
readiness.exportError: Could not download this result. Try again.
readiness.idle: No check has been recorded by this backend. Refresh only reads its current state.
readiness.budgets: Budgets: overall {overall}; each model check {model}; database {database}; gateway {gateway}; separate cleanup allowance {cleanup}. Scheduling and cleanup can add elapsed time.
readiness.runningNote: Checks continue on the backend if you leave this page. Stop remaining checks prevents later probes; a model operation already in progress may continue until its deadline.
readiness.stoppingNote: Stopping remaining checks. Waiting for the current bounded operation and owned-resource cleanup; the shared gateway stays open.
readiness.pollingPaused: Automatic observation has paused after its bounded window. This does not stop backend work. Refresh to read the current result.
readiness.alreadyRunning: Another check is already active. Showing the current shared check.
readiness.startReconciled: The start reply was not confirmed. A passive refresh found this active check; no start request was retried.
readiness.startUncertain: The start reply was not confirmed. No active check could be confirmed. Refresh before deciding whether to run a new check.
readiness.stopReconciled: The stop reply was not confirmed. A passive refresh found the check stopping or finished.
readiness.stopUncertain: The stop request could not be confirmed. The current operation may still be running. Refresh before trying Stop remaining checks again.

results.passed: All required checks and cleanup passed at this time. This is a small capability check, not a full simulation or quality benchmark.
results.failed: Some checks need attention. Review the step results, check your local configuration and services, then run a new check when ready.
results.cancelled: Remaining checks were cancelled after the current operation and cleanup. This result does not confirm all local capabilities.
results.timed_out: A check reached its time budget. Check local service availability or load, then try again when ready.

unavailable.local_mode_required: Local setup checks are available only in local mode.
unavailable.backend_closing: The backend is shutting down and cannot start another check.
unavailable.cleanup_failed: Resource cleanup could not be confirmed. Restart the backend before running another check.
unavailable.inherited_process: This backend inherited another process’s state. Restart it before running a check.

runCaptures.title: Run captures
runCaptures.scope: Save an immutable aggregate observation of a latest saved run, then compare captures from the same simulation or different simulations. Captures preserve counts and saved context after run files change; they are not replay archives or proof of actual process completion.
runCaptures.previewNote: Choose a simulation and preview its latest saved files. Only saved Completed, Stopped or Failed statuses can be captured. Partial or unavailable observations can be saved with their notices. Nothing is saved until you select Save capture.
runCaptures.noCandidates: No saved simulations are available. Return here after a simulation has saved its run.
runCaptures.previewTitle: Latest saved observation · not yet captured
runCaptures.label: Capture label
runCaptures.textLimits: Label: 1–120 characters. Note: up to 2,000 characters. Newlines and tabs are allowed in notes. Labels and notes are saved literally.
runCaptures.recoveryNote: Keep this capture ID to find the record after navigation or reload. Only the ID is kept in the URL; unsaved form text is not retained after reload. Retrying uses the same ID and unchanged submitted text.
runCaptures.savedNote: This is the saved capture from the submitted draft. Preview again to capture a newer observation.
runCaptures.recover: Recover a previous save attempt by checking its capture ID. A missing response does not establish whether the save committed. Reload never retries a save automatically.
runCaptures.emptyLibrary: No captures yet. Preview a saved run and save your first capture.
runCaptures.emptyPage: No captures on this page. Return to the first page.
runCaptures.chooseDetail: Choose View capture in the library to read its saved observation.
runCaptures.compareNote: Choose two different capture IDs. Both may come from the same simulation, including captures made before and after a rerun. The selected IDs remain available while paging.
runCaptures.duplicateSelection: Choose two different capture IDs. The simulation IDs may be the same.
runCaptures.metricsCaption: Counts preserved in the selected captures

saveStates.checking: The save response was not confirmed. Checking the same capture ID before any retry…
saveStates.uncertain: Save not confirmed. Check the saved ID again. Retry is available only after a lookup confirms the record is not present; no automatic save is performed.

runCaptures.storeRecoveryNote: This explicit action lets SQLite roll back an interrupted local write. It does not create captures or reread simulation files. A lost response is not retried automatically; check saved records or explicitly retry recovery.

promptTrialSuite.title: Build a suite from pinned trials
promptTrialSuite.scope: Choose one to five pins to capture their historical inputs and requested settings in a reusable version 1 suite definition. Model observations, recorded replies, source request IDs and outcomes are not included.
promptTrialSuite.offline: Building and downloading work offline. They do not read the runtime, change models or execute prompts. Execution happens separately in Prompt suites.
promptTrialSuite.name: Suite name
promptTrialSuite.nameHint: Enter 1–80 characters with a non-blank name and no control or hidden formatting characters. The name is preserved exactly.
promptTrialSuite.selectionHint: This selection is independent of the two-pin comparison. Cases follow the pin order shown below.
promptTrialSuite.noPins: Pin a finished trial or add a historical trial file above to get started.
promptTrialSuite.capturedNote: Review every captured case below. These are historical inputs and requested settings, not a promise that a current model will use them unchanged. Changing the name, selected pins or their order clears this capture; build again to capture your changes.
promptTrialSuite.checksNote: All expected answers start disabled. A recorded reply is never used as an expected answer.
promptTrialSuite.nextStep: Open Prompt suites, import this definition and review it. Use its separate Run action to execute new trials against the then-current runtime and output limit.
promptTrialSuite.privacy: This file contains the full selected prompts. Keep it private as needed. Repeated downloads use this same capture; Build again creates fresh case IDs.

errors.invalid: Could not build this definition. Check the name and selected trials against the suite input and 128 KiB file limits. No partial definition was created.
errors.download: The download could not be completed. Check your downloads before retrying; a file may already have been saved. The captured definition is retained.

promptTrials.runtimeLink: Try a prompt with the configured local model →
promptTrials.title: Local prompt trials
promptTrials.scope: Run one text prompt with your already configured local chat model. Capture the exact reply, change your prompt, and compare observations side by side.
promptTrials.observationNote: These are observed replies and timings, not quality scores, GPU benchmarks, or verification of model weights. Tools are never executed. Usage is reported by the model server and may be unavailable.
promptTrials.retentionNote: The backend keeps only its latest trial in memory. The next trial replaces it; restarting the backend clears it. Leaving this page stops observation, but does not cancel inference.
promptTrials.stale: This current observation is stale. Pinning and downloading it are disabled until a fresh valid result is read. Previously pinned snapshots remain available.
promptTrials.readError: Could not confirm a valid trial observation. Your prompt draft is preserved.
promptTrials.exportError: Could not prepare the selected trial download.
promptTrials.label: Trial label
promptTrials.labelHint: Required, up to 80 characters. Use a label you can recognize in comparisons.
promptTrials.systemHint: Up to 1,000 characters. Leave empty to omit the system message.
promptTrials.userHint: Required, up to 4,000 characters. Prompts are sent only when you choose Run trial.
promptTrials.outputHint: 1–512 tokens, also limited by the loaded cap: {cap}. A token cap may produce a truncated reply.
promptTrials.validationError: Check the required label and prompt, character limits, temperature (0–1), and output cap (1–512 and within the loaded limit).
promptTrials.runNote: Runs one bounded request, up to 60 seconds plus startup and cleanup. No queue or automatic reruns. Editing this form does not change an already submitted request.
promptTrials.noResult: No trial is available in this observation.
promptTrials.privateExport: Downloads include private prompt and reply content. Review them before sharing.
promptTrials.pinsNote: Up to 10 exact terminal snapshots, held only in this open page. Pins disappear on reload, navigation, or page close. They do not follow later backend changes.
promptTrials.noPins: Pin a completed observation to keep it here while you try another prompt.
promptTrials.importNote: Choose an individual trial JSON or a comparison JSON previously downloaded here. Preview the file, then explicitly add all of its trials to this page’s pins.
promptTrials.importFileHint: One UTF-8 JSON file, up to 512 KiB. The selected file is read locally in this page; it is not uploaded or used to contact a model.
promptTrials.importAdded: Imported trials were added to this page’s pins.
promptTrials.importHistoricalNote: Historical local observations only. The captured model name, availability, and limits describe the saved observation; they do not establish the current model, configuration, or readiness. Reusing inputs requires a separate Run trial with the current local configuration.
promptTrials.importProvenanceNote: Recorded request IDs, fingerprints, and model names are not authenticated. A fingerprint describes request inputs only, not the reply or model weights.

importErrors.invalid: This file could not be read as a valid saved terminal trial or comparison. Choose one UTF-8 JSON file of at most 512 KiB, with a filename of at most 512 characters and 2,048 bytes. Your live observation, pins, and draft are unchanged.
importErrors.duplicate: A request ID in this preview is already pinned. Remove the conflicting pin or choose another file. No trials were added or overwritten.
importErrors.capacity: Adding all trials in this preview would exceed the 10-pin limit. Remove enough pins and try again. No trials were added or evicted.

promptTrials.emptyContent: The model returned an empty reply (0 characters).
promptTrials.emptyRefusal: The server returned an empty refusal field.
promptTrials.timingNote: Request duration includes waiting in the shared queue and transport. Overall duration also includes startup and cleanup. These values are not GPU or model speed benchmarks.
promptTrials.releaseNote: The old request may have run. Releasing keeps your draft and pins, reads the latest status, and lets you explicitly submit a new request when available. It does not cancel or retry the old request.

notices.uncertain: This request’s outcome is not confirmed. Refresh reconciles only its exact request ID and never resends it. No unrelated trial is adopted.
notices.paused: Automatic observation is paused after the bounded observation window. Refresh this request ID to check again; pausing observation does not stop backend work.
notices.rejected: The server did not admit this request. Refresh the latest status before trying again.
notices.released: The previous observation was released. Review the current status and choose Run trial explicitly to create a new request.
notices.stopping: Requesting a stop for this exact trial. Waiting for confirmation.
notices.stopAccepted: The stop was accepted. This trial remains running while bounded cleanup finishes.
notices.stopUncertain: The stop outcome is not confirmed. Reconciliation reads only this exact trial; it never repeats the stop or starts another request.
notices.stopUnconfirmed: A stop is not confirmed for this trial. You can explicitly try Stop waiting again after reviewing this observation.

unavailable.local_mode_required: Prompt trials are available only in local mode.
unavailable.inherited_process: This process cannot own a prompt trial.
unavailable.backend_closing: The backend is closing. New trials are unavailable.
unavailable.cleanup_failed: Trial cleanup failed. Restart the backend before starting another trial.
unavailable.invalid_configuration: The loaded local configuration is invalid. Correct it and restart the backend.

errors.invalid_configuration: The local configuration could not run this request.
errors.gateway_unsupported: This gateway does not support the required request.
errors.request_timeout: The model request reached its time limit.
errors.overall_timeout: The overall trial reached its time limit.
errors.response_too_large: The response exceeded the safe size limit. No reply was retained.
errors.malformed_response: The server response was not a supported completion.
errors.unsupported_completion: The server returned an unsupported completion type. No tools were executed.
errors.model_unavailable: The configured local model was unavailable.
errors.backend_closing: The backend shut down before the trial completed.
errors.user_cancelled: An explicit stop was accepted for this trial request. The model server may continue computing.

promptTrials.stopNote: Stops this trial request and wait. This may affect the same trial in another tab or suite. Queued forwarding is withdrawn if caught before dispatch; work may already have reached the model server and may continue. This does not unload or stop the model server.

promptSuites.title: Repeatable prompt suites
promptSuites.scope: Define a small set of prompts, run them once, and inspect the exact replies from the configured local model.
promptSuites.boundaries: 1–5 cases run sequentially through the existing local trial runner. Each case uses the loaded output limit (at most 512 tokens). The next case starts only after a confirmed successful reply and a fresh readiness check.
promptSuites.retention: Only this page’s current draft and one captured run are held in memory. Leaving the page clears them and stops observation; accepted backend work may continue. No automatic browser or server storage.
promptSuites.stale: Readiness is unconfirmed or stale. Refresh before starting another suite.
promptSuites.backendBusy: The backend reports a running trial. Wait for it to finish, then refresh readiness.
promptSuites.exportError: The download could not be prepared. Your draft and captured run are unchanged.
promptSuites.filesNote: Import a definition up to 128 KiB, review it, then choose whether to replace the draft. Editing and definition downloads work offline. Choosing JSON object upgrades a version 1 draft to version 2; choosing JSON fields upgrades any older draft to version 3. Changing check modes never downgrades the version.
promptSuites.runImportNote: Reuse cases from a saved run report up to 1 MiB. Review the captured cases, then explicitly use them as the editable draft.
promptSuites.importError: This file could not be read or is invalid for the selected import. Definitions are limited to 128 KiB and run reports to 1 MiB. The draft is unchanged.
promptSuites.previewNote: Review all {count} cases below. Using this definition replaces the draft and keeps the captured run. It does not run any prompts.
promptSuites.attentionNote: Selects failed checks and cases without a confirmed successful reply. Successful replies without a check are left out.
promptSuites.capturedSelectionEmpty: Select at least one captured case to use as the draft.
promptSuites.runPreviewNote: The source status, outcomes, checks and times are historical. All captured cases start selected, including unattempted ones. Review the selection before using it as the draft. This keeps the current run and does not restore saved results, resume requests, change model settings or run prompts.
promptSuites.name: Suite name
promptSuites.expectedHint: 0–500 characters. Casing, whitespace, line endings and wrappers must match exactly. An empty field intentionally expects an empty reply.
promptSuites.emptyExpected: The expected reply is the empty string.
promptSuites.duplicateError: Could not duplicate this case. Try again.
promptSuites.validation: The full draft needs a suite name and 1–5 valid cases before it can be exported. Each case needs a label and user prompt; temperature must be 0–1 and the output limit an integer from 1–512. JSON fields needs 1–10 distinct valid names with a type chosen for every field. Prompt, name and expected-reply bounds are shown above.
promptSuites.selectionNote: Selection lasts only for this page session. Excluded cases stay in the draft. New, duplicated and imported cases start included. Run and selected export use the included cases in draft order; full export includes every case.
promptSuites.selectionEmpty: Select at least one case to run or export a selected definition.
promptSuites.selectionInvalid: Complete the suite name and fix the selected cases before running or exporting the selection. Excluded cases do not block these actions.
promptSuites.capExceeded: At least one selected case exceeds the currently loaded output limit of {cap} tokens. Reduce it or exclude that case before running; valid definitions can still be downloaded.
promptSuites.runNote: Run captures the selected cases, checks readiness, and submits each captured case at most once. Later selection changes or draft edits do not change that run or its paused schedule. A new explicit run replaces the previous report only after readiness is confirmed.
promptSuites.pauseNote: Pause holds later model requests while any already accepted case is still observed. Resume scheduling rechecks readiness and continues the captured cases with their original limits; current draft edits and imports do not change them.
promptSuites.pausePending: Pause requested. Waiting for the current request to settle; any accepted case is still observed, and later model requests are held. Resume becomes available once scheduling is paused.
promptSuites.pausedNote: Scheduling paused. Resume scheduling continues the remaining captured cases after a fresh readiness check. Stop scheduling ends this run.
promptSuites.pauseSessionNote: Pause applies only to this open page and is not a saved restart checkpoint. A downloaded paused report remains an unfinished Running capture. Leaving or reloading this page ends its scheduling; accepted backend work may continue.
promptSuites.stopNote: Stop scheduling prevents further cases from starting. An already accepted case may keep running; observation continues where possible. It does not cancel backend computation.
promptSuites.capturedNote: Draft edits and imports do not change this captured definition or its results. Partial and terminal reports can be downloaded, up to 1 MiB.
promptSuites.noRun: No suite has started on this page.
promptSuites.stopRequested: No more cases will be scheduled.
promptSuites.reconcileNote: The last case could not be confirmed. Read its exact request ID again to update this report. This never resubmits it or resumes remaining cases. Accepted backend work may still be running.
promptSuites.checkNote: Exact reply checks are literal comparisons, not a measure of model accuracy or answer quality. Only confirmed successful replies are evaluated; a mismatch may continue, while other outcomes halt the suite.
promptSuites.privacy: Definitions contain your prompts; captured-run downloads also contain replies and model observations. Keep these files private as needed. Downloads never call the model.

phases.waiting: Waiting before the next observation or case…

errors.invalid_definition: The suite definition is invalid. Review the case bounds and try again.
errors.read_failed: The observation could not be read. No additional cases will start automatically.
errors.invalid_observation: The backend observation was not valid. No additional cases will start automatically.
errors.identity_mismatch: The returned trial did not match the captured request. No additional cases will start automatically.
errors.backend_unavailable: The local trial runner is unavailable. Refresh readiness after checking its configuration.
errors.backend_running: Another trial is running. No case was admitted; refresh readiness when it finishes.
errors.loaded_cap: A case exceeds the loaded output limit. Reduce the draft limit before a new run.
errors.admission_rejected: The backend rejected this admission. It will not be retried automatically.
errors.observation_limit: The bounded observation window ended. Reconcile the unresolved case explicitly.
errors.invalid_identity: A valid unique request identity could not be prepared. No additional cases will start.
errors.runtime_failed: This case did not complete successfully. Remaining cases were not attempted.

resumeErrors.read_failed: Readiness could not be read. Scheduling stays paused. Choose Resume scheduling to retry the check.
resumeErrors.invalid_observation: The readiness response was not valid. Scheduling stays paused. Choose Resume scheduling to retry the check.
resumeErrors.backend_unavailable: The local trial runner is unavailable. Scheduling stays paused. Check its configuration, then choose Resume scheduling to recheck readiness.
resumeErrors.backend_running: Another trial is running. Scheduling stays paused. When it finishes, choose Resume scheduling to recheck readiness.
resumeErrors.loaded_cap: A captured case exceeds the loaded output limit. Scheduling stays paused. Restore a sufficient limit and choose Resume scheduling, or stop and start a new run with edited limits. Draft edits cannot change this run.

promptSuites.jsonObjectHint: Checks format only: the entire reply must be one JSON object, including an empty object. Surrounding JSON whitespace and nested arrays are allowed. Limit: 64 KiB of UTF-8 and value depth 16 (root depth 0). Rejects wrappers, trailing content, duplicate decoded keys, nonfinite numbers and unpaired surrogates. No repair, schema validation, numeric-precision guarantee or answer-quality assessment. This does not request a JSON response format from the model.
promptSuites.formatCheckNote: Checks evaluate only confirmed successful replies. Exact text compares the complete reply literally; JSON object checks bounded format; JSON fields also checks the required top-level names and types. These checks do not measure model accuracy or answer quality. A failed check may continue; other run outcomes halt the suite.
promptSuites.requiredFieldsHint: Add 1–10 distinct literal field names and choose a JSON type for each. Names use 1–80 Unicode characters and cannot be blank or contain control, format, surrogate, private-use or unassigned characters. Casing, Unicode spelling and outer spaces are significant. Names such as a.b are literal keys, not nested paths.
promptSuites.jsonFieldsHint: The complete successful reply must pass the strict JSON object check and contain each named top-level field with the chosen type. Extra fields are allowed; object and array rules check only the container, not its children. Limit: 64 KiB UTF-8 and value depth 16 (root depth 0). Rejects wrappers, trailing content, duplicate decoded keys, nonfinite numbers and unpaired surrogates. No nested schema, numeric-precision guarantee or meaning check. This checks captured replies only and does not change the model request or settings.

promptSuiteComparison.title: Compare captured prompt-suite runs
promptSuiteComparison.scope: Import two exported runs to inspect exact replies, inputs and recorded observations side by side.
promptSuiteComparison.offline: This page works offline. Reading files, comparing and downloading make no backend or model requests. Reports stay in page memory; leaving clears them. Report data is not saved to browser storage.
promptSuiteComparison.limits: Choose exported version 1, 2 or 3 suite-run JSON files, up to 1 MiB each. Review each preview, then explicitly use it. Comparison bundles cannot be imported as runs.
promptSuiteComparison.importError: The file could not be read as a valid UTF-8 suite-run report, or exceeds 1 MiB. Previously accepted reports and captured comparisons are unchanged.
promptSuiteComparison.retained: The previously accepted report is still in this slot. The replacement was not accepted; any captured comparison still refers to the accepted reports.
promptSuiteComparison.emptySlot: No report has been accepted for this slot.
promptSuiteComparison.previewNote: Using this report replaces this slot and clears the captured comparison and its downloads. It does not run any prompts.
promptSuiteComparison.sameRun: Choose two different suite run IDs. A copy of the same run is not a second run.
promptSuiteComparison.compareError: These accepted reports could not be compared. Review both reports and try again.
promptSuiteComparison.exportError: The download could not be prepared, or a comparison export exceeds 4 MiB. The captured comparison remains available on this page.
promptSuiteComparison.historical: This is a historical comparison of the two accepted reports identified below. A replacement preview, failed read or discarded file does not update it. Accepting a report, clearing or swapping slots retires it; choose Compare reports again.
promptSuiteComparison.privacy: Downloads contain full prompts, expected replies, model replies and recorded configurations. Both formats use the same fixed capture and are limited to 4 MiB each. Handle these files with appropriate privacy.
promptSuiteComparison.mixed: This report contains multiple observed model/reasoning configurations. Inspect each case separately.
promptSuiteComparison.configurationNote: Model names and server defaults are recorded labels. They do not authenticate model weights or prove that a setting was honored. No equivalence of hardware, warm-up or environment is assumed.
promptSuiteComparison.orderChanged: The relative order of shared cases changed. Positions and membership are shown for every case.
promptSuiteComparison.findingsNote: Paired findings require identical evaluation inputs, two successful recorded rows and request IDs absent from the other report. Exact-check transitions also require the same enabled expected reply. Literal equality is not a measure of accuracy or answer quality.
promptSuiteComparison.timingNote: Duration differences are comparison minus baseline for each eligible case with two recorded request durations. These are individual observations, not speed benchmarks or aggregate performance. Overall elapsed duration is separate and includes startup and cleanup; request duration can include queue and transport waiting.
promptSuiteComparison.inputsChanged: Evaluation inputs changed; this case is excluded from paired findings
promptSuiteComparison.absentCase: This case is absent from this report.
promptSuiteComparison.requestIdOverlap: A request ID for this case also appears in the other report; paired findings are excluded.
promptSuiteComparison.checkFindingsNote: Paired findings require identical evaluation inputs and check kinds, two successful recorded rows and request IDs absent from the other report. Exact text requires the same expected reply; JSON fields requires the same names and types, regardless of rule order. Check transitions require an enabled check. JSON checks validate bounded object format and, when requested, top-level fields and types, not nested schema or answer quality. Literal reply equality still compares the full text.

localPlan.title: Plan a local simulation
localPlan.waiting: Waiting for the previous environment cleanup attempt to finish.
localPlan.checking: Checking the saved preparation and local limits…
localPlan.limits: Local limits: {agents} agents, {selectable} selectable per preparation, {rounds} maximum rounds, {concurrency} concurrent profile workers.
localPlan.invalidLimits: Local limits are missing or invalid. Fix the runtime configuration, then refresh the plan.
localPlan.observing: A preparation is already active. Watching its progress; no new preparation will be started.
localPlan.busyError: Another operation owns this simulation or its graph. Wait for it to finish, then refresh the plan.
localPlan.saved: Saved preparation is available for {count} agents.
localPlan.savedHint: Reuse the saved cast and configuration. Its original profile mode is not recorded. To change the cast, create a new simulation.
localPlan.loadHint: Load cast connects to local graph memory and loads eligible entities. It may initialize local graph resources. It does not generate profiles or configuration.
localPlan.templateHint: Template profiles use entity data without per-agent model or embedding calls.
localPlan.llmHint: LLM profiles use model calls and graph context. Existing fallback behavior may provide template profiles if an individual generation fails.
localPlan.configModelHint: Simulation configuration generation still uses the model in both modes.
localPlan.roundsHint: Enter a whole number from 1 to {cap}. This is an upper bound. Actual rounds are the smallest of the configured rounds, your maximum, and the local cap.
localPlan.effectiveRounds: Effective configured total: {rounds} rounds. This is simulated time, not a wall-clock estimate.
localPlan.configuredUnknown: Configured rounds are unavailable. The runner will validate the saved configuration when started.
localPlan.invalidRounds: Enter a whole number within the loaded local round limit.
localPlan.changedError: The graph, selection, or saved files changed. Refresh the plan and load the cast again before preparing.
localPlan.savedError: The saved preparation cannot be used or replaced here. Refresh the plan to check it; create a new simulation to prepare a different cast.
localPlan.sizeError: This source exceeds the supported local planning size. Use a smaller source or graph, then refresh the plan.
localPlan.requestError: The request could not be completed. Refresh the plan to check current state before trying again.
localPlan.graphHint: Local graph preview stays unloaded until you choose Refresh. Load cast in the planner loads only eligible entities.
localPlan.cancelHint: Stops queued profiles and later stages. Work already running may finish.
localPlan.cancelling: Cancellation requested. Waiting for running work and cleanup to finish.
localPlan.finalizing: Preparation is finalizing. Cancellation is no longer available.
localPlan.cancelledHint: Partial files remain for inspection. To try again, return to the project and create another simulation.
localPlan.cancelUnavailable: Cleanup is blocked or preparation ownership is unavailable. This simulation cannot be prepared, reused, or started.
localPlan.cancelTooLate: Preparation is already finalizing, so cancellation was too late. Waiting for the result.
localPlan.cancelUnknown: Could not confirm the cancellation request. Checking task status before another attempt.
localPlan.cancelRetryAvailable: The latest task status still allows cancellation. You can retry cancellation.

localCastPreset.title: Local cast preset
localCastPreset.scope: Save cast choices for fresh generation on this project and graph, including a new simulation. A preset does not freeze graph facts, profiles, prompts, configuration or artifact state.
localCastPreset.loadFirst: First choose Load cast to verify the current project, graph and eligible entities. Saved preparation without a retained selection cannot be exported.
localCastPreset.fileHint: JSON only, up to 256 KiB. Opening a file only previews its choices. Apply replaces the cast, profile mode and maximum rounds; prepare explicitly afterward.
localCastPreset.compatible: Compatible with the loaded cast and current limits. Ready to apply to this idle simulation.
localCastPreset.applyUnavailable: These choices match the loaded cast, but applying requires an idle, unprepared local simulation after cleanup.
localCastPreset.applied: Preset applied to the draft. Choose Prepare selected cast when ready.
localCastPreset.retainedDraft: Save exports the valid choices retained in this view, even after preparation or cancellation. It does not export generated artifacts.

errors.invalid_preset: This is not a valid local cast preset. Check the version, exact fields, IDs and value types.
errors.file_too_large: The preset exceeds the 256 KiB file limit.
errors.invalid_utf8: The file must contain valid UTF-8 JSON.
errors.invalid_catalog: The current cast binding or limits cannot be verified. Load the cast from a valid local plan.
errors.identity_mismatch: This preset belongs to a different project or graph.
errors.selection_unavailable: One or more selected entity IDs are absent from the current cast.
errors.agent_limit_exceeded: The preset selects more entities than the current local limit allows.
errors.round_limit_exceeded: The preset maximum rounds exceeds the current local limit.
errors.read_failed: The preset file could not be read. Your current draft was kept.
errors.download_failed: The preset download could not be created. Your current draft was kept.

promptExamples.title: Prepare reviewed prompt examples
promptExamples.scope: Import one captured suite run, write target replies and explicitly approve the targets you want to export.
promptExamples.offline: This page works offline on an imported report. It makes no runtime requests, changes no model and performs no training.
promptExamples.limits: Accepts suite-run report versions 1–3, with 1–5 cases, up to 1 MiB in UTF-8. JSONL is bounded to 1 MiB and the review JSON to 4 MiB.
promptExamples.importError: The file could not be accepted. Choose a valid bounded UTF-8 suite-run report.
promptExamples.retained: The accepted source, targets, approvals and built bundle are retained. The replacement has not been used.
promptExamples.empty: No source report has been accepted.
promptExamples.previewNote: Use this report to replace the accepted source. Every target starts empty and unapproved; using a replacement clears existing targets, approvals and downloads.
promptExamples.historical: The recorded outcome, reply, refusal, prompts, check and settings remain historical observations. Editing a target does not change the source or mean the model produced that target.
promptExamples.repeatedInputs: Distinct cases with repeated inputs may produce duplicate or conflicting examples. Each approved case is retained separately; review your selections.
promptExamples.targetBounds: Approval requires nonblank text. Curation drafts may contain empty or whitespace-only targets. Each target is limited to 16,384 Unicode code points and 64 KiB UTF-8. Control characters are not allowed except carriage return, line feed and tab. Text is preserved exactly.
promptExamples.invalidTarget: Approval requires nonblank text within the character and byte limits, without unsupported control characters. Curation drafts can retain empty or whitespace-only targets within the same limits.
promptExamples.editNote: Editing or copying a target removes its approval and any built bundle immediately. Copying only creates a draft.
promptExamples.checkNote: Checks only compare literal text or the requested JSON format and fields. A check does not establish correctness, quality or suitability for training. A mismatch can still be explicitly approved.
promptExamples.approvalError: This target could not be approved. Review it and try again.
promptExamples.selectionNote: Only explicitly approved targets are selected. Build 1–5 examples in the original source-case order.
promptExamples.buildError: The examples could not be built within the export limits. Your target drafts and approvals are retained.
promptExamples.exportError: The download could not be created. The captured bundle is retained; try again.
promptExamples.bundleNote: Both downloads use this same captured bundle. JSONL contains selected prompt messages and approved targets. The review JSON adds selected source observations and approval metadata. These files do not establish training sufficiency, model compatibility or improvement.
promptExamples.privacy: Downloads contain selected prompts, targets and, in the review file, recorded replies and observations. Keep them private as needed.
promptExamples.draftLimits: Curation draft JSON files may be up to 4 MiB in UTF-8. Their embedded source report must meet the original 1 MiB report limit. Reviewed-example JSON and JSONL are not curation drafts.
promptExamples.draftImportError: The curation draft could not be accepted. Choose a valid UTF-8 curation draft up to 4 MiB with a valid source report up to 1 MiB.
promptExamples.draftPreviewNote: Use this draft to replace the accepted source and restore every target exactly as shown. All approvals will be reset and the built bundle cleared. Review and approve targets again before building selected examples.
promptExamples.fullDraftSource: Full captured source report and metadata
promptExamples.draftPrivacy: This download contains ALL source prompts and replies and ALL target drafts, including unapproved and empty targets. Keep it private as needed. No automatic saving or browser storage is used. The draft contains no approvals; targets must be approved again after restoring it.
promptExamples.draftExportError: The curation draft download could not be completed. Check your downloads before retrying; a file may already have been saved. Also check every target's character and byte limits and unsupported control characters. Current targets, approvals and any built bundle are retained.

savedReportComparison.title: Compare captured report text
savedReportComparison.scope: These are temporary, independent observations of literal saved text. They are not a common atomic snapshot, a version archive, or a semantic quality assessment. Captures stay fixed while you browse; leaving this page clears them. The URL does not save the pair.
savedReportComparison.instructions: Open a report in the reader, then capture it on either side. Open another report or reopen the same ID to capture another observation. Replacing or clearing a capture is explicit.
savedReportComparison.emptySlot: No report captured on this side.
savedReportComparison.needPair: Capture both sides to compare their exact saved text.
savedReportComparison.truncated: Preview limited to the first 64 KiB of UTF-8 text. Download the exact source for the full captured document.
savedReportComparison.lineNote: Line numbers: left / right. Endings and blank lines are shown explicitly; a changed line counts as a removal and an addition.

results.identical: Captured texts are exactly identical. Added: 0; removed: 0.
results.different: Captured texts differ. Complete line comparison: {added} added; {removed} removed.
results.unavailable: Text comparison unavailable: at least one captured body is unavailable. Added and removed counts are unknown.
results.limited: Captured texts differ. Line comparison is limited / unavailable in-page; added and removed counts are unknown. Exact source downloads remain available.

limits.bytes: Each diff input must be at most 64 KiB of UTF-8 text.
limits.lines: Each diff input must have at most 2,000 logical lines.
limits.cells: The line comparison exceeds the 1,000,000-cell work budget.
limits.rows: The line comparison exceeds the 4,000-row output budget.

savedActivityRounds.title: Activity by round
savedActivityRounds.entry: Explore all rounds for this platform
savedActivityRounds.scope: This overview covers all saved attempts for its own platform and inclusive round range. Record-page phrase, agent, type and outcome filters do not apply here.
savedActivityRounds.filterNote: Use nonnegative decimal rounds with up to 64 digits; zero is valid. Leave bounds blank for all observed rounds. Apply preserves the observed revision; Refresh reads the latest files using the applied URL filters.
savedActivityRounds.orderNote: Observed rounds in ascending numeric order. Gaps are not filled; a requested or last-saved round does not prove it executed.
savedActivityRounds.draftNote: Filters have changed. Apply filters to read a new overview; the previous observation and its links are retired.
savedActivityRounds.partialNote: Partial counts cover only readable, valid observations. An em dash means unavailable, not zero. Downloads include all rows of this accepted overview, including rows on other local pages.
savedActivityRounds.tableCaption: Saved attempt counts by observed round · positive counts open matching saved records
savedActivityRounds.unsupportedRound: This saved round has more than 64 decimal digits. Its counts can be exported; exact record drilldown is unavailable.
savedActivityRounds.pagePosition: Local page {page} of {pages} · 25 rows per page

errors.generic: The saved round overview could not be loaded. Apply filters or Refresh to try again.
errors.invalid_selection: The URL contains an invalid selection. Use one simulation ID and one value for each supported platform, round bound and revision.
errors.invalid_filters: Use Twitter or Reddit and inclusive nonnegative decimal round bounds of up to 64 digits. The from round cannot exceed the to round.
errors.invalid_revision: The saved revision in this URL is invalid. Refresh to read the latest saved files.
errors.unsafe_path: This saved record cannot be safely read. Return to history and choose another simulation.
errors.simulation_not_found: This saved simulation no longer exists. Return to history and choose another simulation.
errors.simulation_unreadable: This saved simulation record could not be read. Refresh to try again.
errors.simulation_active: The saved run is marked active. Wait until it has stopped, then Refresh.
errors.sources_changed: The saved files changed. Refresh to read the latest files for the applied platform and round range.
errors.too_many_rounds: More than 1000 observed matching rounds cannot be returned safely. Narrow the platform or inclusive round range, then Apply filters.
errors.response_too_large: The overview exceeds the 1 MiB response limit. Narrow the platform or inclusive round range, then Apply filters.

savedInterviews.title: Saved interviews
savedInterviews.scope: Review interviews in the current platform databases. Restart can replace these files; this is not an archive of previous runs.
savedInterviews.contextNote: Saved prompts may include prior context. These records do not reconstruct conversation sessions, survey batches, historical names or model versions.
savedInterviews.filterNote: Optional exact agent ID: 0 to 9223372036854775807, without signs, spaces or leading zeroes. Apply filters to read a new observation.
savedInterviews.downloadNote: Download all accepted rows and source metadata as plaintext JSON, including prompts and replies. This uses the displayed observation, without another storage read.
savedInterviews.orderNote: Twitter and Reddit are observed separately. Records stay grouped by platform, in descending saved row order; timestamps do not establish an order across platforms.
savedInterviews.draftNote: Filters have unapplied edits. The previous observation and its download have been retired. Apply filters, or Refresh the filters in the URL.
savedInterviews.limitsNote: At most {count} matching rows per platform and {total} overall are returned. This is a bounded observation, not a total count.
savedInterviews.moreAvailable: More matching saved rows are available beyond this observation. Narrow the filters to inspect another selection.
savedInterviews.unknownMore: Whether more matching rows exist is unknown for this source.
savedInterviews.empty: No matching saved interviews in this successfully read source.
savedInterviews.rawPreview: Raw payload preview (not decoded as a prompt and reply)
savedInterviews.truncated: Truncated: saved payload or timestamp exceeded the preview limit.
savedInterviews.pagePosition: Page {page} of {pages}; download includes all accepted rows

statuses.too_large: Database or WAL exceeds the read limit

warnings.source_unreadable: The source could not be read fully.
warnings.database_too_large: The database exceeds the 160 MiB read limit.
warnings.wal_too_large: The WAL exceeds the 64 MiB read limit.
warnings.query_limited: The SQLite query reached its execution budget.
warnings.row_limit: The per-platform row limit was reached.
warnings.response_limit: The response size limit omitted additional rows.
warnings.record_warnings: Some returned records have missing, invalid or truncated saved fields.
warnings.invalid_agent_id: The saved agent ID is invalid; no identity is inferred.
warnings.timestamp_truncated: The saved timestamp preview was truncated.
warnings.invalid_payload_type: The payload has an unexpected storage type.
warnings.invalid_utf8: Invalid UTF-8 was replaced in the text preview.
warnings.invalid_json: The payload is not valid JSON.
warnings.invalid_payload_shape: The payload is not a JSON object.
warnings.invalid_payload_fields: Prompt or response has an invalid type; a raw preview is shown.
warnings.payload_truncated: The payload exceeds the 16 KiB preview limit.

errors.download: The download could not be completed. Check your downloads before retrying; a file may already have been saved. Your accepted observation is retained.
errors.generic: Saved interviews could not be loaded safely. Refresh to try again.
errors.invalid_selection: This simulation identifier is invalid. Return to History and select a simulation.
errors.invalid_filters: Use only an optional Twitter or Reddit platform and an exact agent ID from 0 to 9223372036854775807, without leading zeroes.
errors.unsafe_path: This saved record cannot be safely read. Return to History and choose another simulation.
errors.interviews_unavailable: Saved interviews could not be read. Refresh to try again.
errors.response_too_large: The observation exceeds the response size limit. Narrow the platform or exact agent ID and apply filters.
